name: Vigilance
text: **Vigilance**: Some elves train to fight against demons and evil fey with a zeal that leaves them little time to hone their magic traditions. Elves with this racial trait gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC against attacks by chaotic creatures. This trait replaces elven magic.
